sources.evidence: Aruba Aloe's official factory tour page identifies its factory in Hato, Aruba and describes the production process through the aloe cutting room, testing lab, filling, packing and storage areas; it also identifies Skin, Hair & Sun Care products made with Aruba aloe.
The official contact page lists the Aruba Aloe Factory, Museum & Store at Pitastraat 115, Oranjestad, Aruba with current opening hours.

name: Curaçao Liqueur Distillery at Landhuis Chobolobo

sources.evidence: Senior & Co.'s official distillation-process page describes the current hand distillation and bottling process for Genuine Curaçao Liqueur, including distillation, filtering, filling bottles, labeling and sealing, and explicitly names Blue Curaçao as a final product.
The official contact page identifies the Curaçao Liqueur Distillery at Landhuis Chobolobo in Willemstad, Curaçao and provides current visiting hours.
The official brand site lists Orange Curaçao and states that Senior produces Genuine Curaçao Liqueur from Curaçao at the distillery.
